messages:
emma: did a quick keyboard + SR run on the updated console panels. small things: focus outline on compact rows is too subtle in light theme, the details panel content isn't marked as role="region" with an accessible name, and the mini status pill drops below 3:1 on light bg. attaching quick gif: https://assets.redwood/a11y/panel-keyboard.gif :mag:

dinesh: great catches. for the region naming, we usually do `role="region" aria-label="Details for selected model"` on the panel wrapper so SR users can jump to it.

leah: for focus outline on light theme, can we use `:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0b5fff; outline-offset: 2px }` only for keyboard users? avoids mouse noise and meets 3:1.

paul: question: the status pill is small (10px badge) — contrast failures are expected. option A: increase stroke/outline color for the badge; option B: provide visible text label in the legend and `aria-label` on the pill. leaning to both.

a11y-bot: automated scan (axe) summary: 4 violations  color-contrast (1), landmark (1), focus-order (1), aria-roles (1). full report: https://ci.redwood/axe/1761239876

dinesh: small CSS snippet for skip-link reveal (we forgot to surface it on keyboard):

```
.skip-link { position: absolute; left: -9999px }
.skip-link:focus { left: 12px; top: 12px; padding: 8px; background: var(--bg-elev); z-index: 1000 }
```

use our sr-only token normally but ensure it's not permanently offscreen when focused.

leah: i'll update the panel to include `role="region" aria-label="Selected item details"` and add `tabindex="-1"` on the title so we can programmatically focus it on open.

paul: i'll darken the badge outline to #2b6cb0 and add `aria-label="Status: Running"` on the pill. that'll satisfy SR and visual contrast.

dinesh: i'll add a tiny focus-trap invocation for the panel open path — we missed it during the last refactor. small unit test to assert first focusable receives focus.

emma: nice. can we also ensure toasts use `role="status" aria-live="polite"` (non-critical) so they don't steal focus? quick check shows some toasts still use `role="alert"`.

a11y-bot: note: tests flagged 2 components using `role="alert"` for non-critical success toasts.

leah: noted. i'll change to `status` for success & info, keep `alert` for errors only.

dinesh: timeline: i'll open a PR with focus trap + skip-link fix; leah will update ARIA attributes + toast roles; paul will patch badge contrast. aiming for review today.

emma: thanks team — i'll run a follow-up axe + VoiceOver pass after PRs go in and report back. tiny but important wins :sparkles:
